gaps.statement: Capability is over-transferred beyond declared operational design domains.
Degradation and safe fallback are detached from fleet-expansion narratives.
Mixed traffic and vulnerable-road-user interaction remain underrepresented as deployment conditions.
V2X and road infrastructure lack explicit availability, integrity, latency, and failure boundaries.
Safety evidence lacks a common claim-to-evidence scaling contract.
Trust, privacy, responsibility, and communication are often outside technical rollout decisions.
Service exclusion and accessibility effects can be hidden by fleet averages.
